name: Noble Deaths
summary: Magistrate Henry Maleb fears that the Syndicate's leaders are bent on Southshore's ruin and wants them struck down before their plans come to pass. You are to head north into the Alterac Mountains, to Strahnbrad's ruins, which the Syndicate is thought to use as a headquarters.

sections.title: Hunting the Syndicate's Leaders
sections.body: After Foreboding Plans, Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore wants the Syndicate's leadership dealt with before its plans are realized. The Syndicate's cutthroats answer to former Alterac nobles, who may be hiding as ordinary agents. A noble can be known by the signet ring worn. Maleb asks for seven Alterac signet rings to be brought back to him in Southshore, and he thinks the Syndicate has made a headquarters of Strahnbrad's ruins, up north in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: Maleb's Hope
sections.body: Maleb is convinced that a Syndicate without its nobility could no longer act with decision, and would be reduced to common thugs.

faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore sends you north, to strike at the leaders behind the Syndicate.

faq.q: Where are the Syndicate nobles located?
faq.answer: Maleb thinks the Syndicate has made a headquarters of Strahnbrad's ruins, up north in the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: How can you tell the nobles apart from ordinary Syndicate members?
faq.answer: The nobles may hide as normal Syndicate agents, but each can be known by the signet ring worn.
